Spectral Hateweavers are Maldraxxi necromancers located at the Temple of Courage in Bastion. They can be seen on top of Flayedwing Wraiths flying above the temple.

.]] The Spellbook & Professions interface allowed players to inspect their abilities and professions. The default keybinding was . The interface has two tabs for most classes: Spellbook and Professions; while hunters have an additional tab: Pet.
Spellforged Destroyer is a titan construct located at the Forge of Arcanum in the Azure Span.
The Spellbound War Chest can be found atop the pyramid in Zul'Farrak. It can only be opened with the Emblem of Blood Magic.
Spider Poison was a hunter pet ability taught by spider trainers during the beta.
Spineshell Snapjaws are dragon turtles located in Island Expeditions.
Spineshell Turtles are dragon turtles located in Island Expeditions.
Spirit Burst is a Havoc demon hunter ability. It is the transformed version of Spirit Bomb during Metamorphosis (Vengeance) with the Demonic Intensity hero talent.
Spiked Shell is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.
Spirit Fragments are mogu clones summoned by Shan'ze Illusionists at Shan'ze Dao in the Townlong Steppes when they use their Spirit Split ability.
Spineclaw Sandsnappers are deepsea crabs found in Island Expeditions.
Spineclaw Rockshells are deepsea crabs found in Island Expeditions.
Spirited Stag's Helm is a quest reward from Power, Eruption, and Lies and Triple Threat (quest).
Spirited Stag's Handguards are a quest reward from Flight and Fight and Light 'Em Up!.
Spirited Stag's Chestguard is a quest reward from Defense of the Ancients (quest) and Power, Eruption, and Lies.

Spiritpaw Marathon is an exploration achievement earned for assisting the Spiritpaw Runner in Zul'Aman. Speak with Feevra at and then speak with the Kapara Pup nearby at to get the buff that lasts for 30 minutes. Do not mount as it will remove the buff. Start running toward , the Shrine of Filo island, and step into the highlighted circle to receive the achievement.
The Spiritwing Emperor is a big glimmerfly found just northwest of Ithys' Basin in Bastion.
Spiritual Imbalance is an ability card from the Crown of the Heavens set.
Spiritual Harmony is an ability card from the Worldbreaker set.
Spiritual Return is an ability card from the Worldbreaker set.

Splintered Spark of Dreams drops from Amirdrassil, the Dream's Hope bosses and are contained in weekly task caches such as Malicia's Hoard and the Satchel of Dreams. During Dragonflight Season 3, it was sold by Evantkis in Valdrakken for 6 Aspects' Token of Merit
Splice 'n Dice drops from Izo, the Grand Splicer in the City of Threads.

A Spreader Hatchery accompanies any delves with the Web Spreaders (hatcheries) affix. They spawn a Web Spreader that patrols around the hatchery and spit webs that summon nerubians under their path. If the local Web Spreader is killed, the hatchery will eventually summon another one. Destroy the hatchery to prevent them from spawning.
Squally is a stormrook companion. Obtaining this pet rewards the Squally (achievement) feat of strength.
Spring Butterfly Polearm is available for 30x Love Token during Love is in the Air from Kiera Torres in Elwynn Forest and Lythianne Morningspear in Durotar.
Spring Butterfly Mace is available for 30x Love Token during Love is in the Air from Kiera Torres in Elwynn Forest and Lythianne Morningspear in Durotar.
Spring Butterfly Wand is available for 30x Love Token during Love is in the Air from Kiera Torres in Elwynn Forest and Lythianne Morningspear in Durotar.
Spring Butterfly Longbow is available for 30x Love Token during Love is in the Air from Kiera Torres in Elwynn Forest and Lythianne Morningspear in Durotar.
Spring-Powered Undermine Chair is housing decor purchased from Rocco Razzboom in Undermine for .
Spring-Powered Pointer is housing decor purchased from Shredz the Scrapper in Undermine for .
Srax'run is a nerubian found in the Burrows in the City of Threads.
Stabilized Derivate is a crafting reagent used in Midnight Alchemy. They are obtained by alchemists using the Recycle Flasks or Recycle Potions abilities.
Stacks Topskimmer is a goblin found at the Incontinental Hotel in Undermine.
Sssensational! is a collection achievement earned by completing one of the achievements or feats of strength listed.
Stacks of Bandages are found in Thunder Totem in Highmountain.
Sszorak's Ferocity drops from Sszorak in The Venomous Abyss.

Star Points are a type of currency earned by acquiring a duplicate of the mini. It is not shared; each mini has its own count. It is needed along with Upgrade Cores and Arclight Energy to upgrade a unit in rarity.
The Star-Touched Dragonegg can be found at Agol'watha in the during Nightmare Incursions.
Star Lotus can be gathered with Herbalism (250) in the during Nightmare Incursions.
Star Trick Rats are rats found in front of Horace the Rat Whisperer in Slam Central Station in Undermine.
Star Ruby Bracelet of Friendship is available for purchase at the Trading Post for 50 Trader's Tender.
Stalwart Bear Form is an instant ability card from the Throne of the Tides set.

The Station house is an office located in an unknown part of Gilneas City, which was used by the detectives Halford Ramsey and Cox for their interrogations. Four days before the Wolf Cult's attack on the capital, the Gilnean newspaper owner Maxwell Wiggins was interrogated here. Halford questioned him about the information in his latest articles about the murders committed by the Starlight Slasher, notably that all the victims were supporters of King Genn Greymane at the time of the Northgate Rebellion, which had not been revealed by the authorities. When Wiggins attempted to defend himself by mentioning private sources, Halford suspected him of being a member of the Wolf Cult, but they were
Steadfast as the Peaks is a Mountain Thane hero talent for warriors. It is an exclusive choice node with Keep Your Feet on the Ground.

The Statue of the Great Wolf is located in the Emerald Dream. Interacting with it with the Mark of Goldrinn, Moonfang's Paw, or as a worgen or shaman's Ghost Wolf summons the Boon of Goldrinn that contains Claw of Lo'Gosh.
The Statue of Alleria is found in Triad's Conservatory in Eredath during The Path Taken, observed by Arator. It represents the one in Stormwind City.
Steam-Powered Wristwatch drops from XT-Minecrusher 8700 in a cave near Mmarl in Azj-Kahet.
Steam-Powered Golden Cloak is available for purchase at the Trading Post for 300 Trader's Tender.

A pair of Starry-Eyed Goggles is a toy contained in the Astral Chest at in room #3 (the moonkin room) of Ratts' Revenge. The chest requires the Astral Key, which is fished up from the bowl of Astral Soup in the same room. Using the Starry-Eyed Goggles grants the user a buff that alters their vision in several ways, such as changing the skybox and making some otherwise invisible objects visible. This is part of the secret to obtain Incognitro, the Indecipherable Felcycle.
Steam-Powered Green Cloak is an appearance unlocked through the use of Arsenal: Green Clockwork Contraptions Collection.
Steady Snap is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.
Starved Crawlers are undercrawlers located in Ara-Kara, City of Echoes.

Steamy Romance Novels are located on the beach at Southfury River in the Northern Barrens and Olivia's Pond in Stormwind City during Love is in the Air. Approaching the area applies the buff and looting the books gives a copy of a Steamy Romance Novel. Near them are Reading Chairs and beverage - Glass of Wine, Cup of Kafa, and Lemon Silverleaf Tea.
Stello is a goblin located near the Incontinental Hotel in the Undermine.

Steamwheedle Runoff are pools that can be found in the Undermine. They are the best way for anglers willing to risk life and limb in the Undermine's chemical pits and the eel-infested Blackwater Marina to obtain the elusive "Gold" Fish. Apart from these fish, they are also host to an array of vendor trash. Note that these pools can sometimes be difficult to see in the radiant industrial waste, and that they are best tracked with the Find Fish ability.
Steelgaze Basilisks are basilisks found inside the Echoing Halls in Highmountain.
Sing Like a Bee is an Outlaw rogue talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Float Like a Butterfly.
Sticky Surge is an ability used by Petal during a Pet Battle.

Sticky Gossamer Sac is sold by Uvo'rek the Broodmother and Violesca in the City of Threads for . It is also sold by Izkrk'tkrzn for . If the player knows Recipe: Fine Egg Powder, they can grind the item to produce Fine Egg Powder (and possibly Coagulated Yolk) under the cooking menu interface. Buying this egg from Izkrk'tkrzn costs the least amount of kej.

Sterling Alloy is a bar crafting reagent made with and used extensively in Midnight Blacksmithing. The ability to make this item can be learned from Bemarrin, Chrysalius, and Arathel Sunforge for once the blacksmith's skill in Midnight Blacksmithing has reached 25.

Stoltria was the second-in-command of Levarian during the War of the Scaleborn. Stoltria played a role in Vitelenoth's death at the talons of Bojsanz and led a unit of onyx reavers in the defense of Valdrakken during the Primalists' final push on the city. When Levarian was struck down during the war's final battle at Harrowsdeep, she rallied his Earthen Bulwark to continue the battle.
Stolen Kirin Tor Artifacts drop from the Candlelit kobolds at Mourning Rise on the Isle of Dorn. Kalecgos wants 15 of them for Trinkets, Curios and Other Powerful Objects.
Stolen Loader is an ironstrider located in delves as a Strange Disturbance. A Kobold Thief is driving it. Defeating it provides the Loader Signal delve power from a dropped Molten Engine.
Stone Guard's Badges drop from Dark Horde Warrior and Hulking Crushers in Blackrock Mountain.
Stone Fiend Saboteurs are stone fiends flying in groups around the Redelav District in Revendreth.
Stone Shackles are found at the Obsidian Citadel on the Waking Shores during Hands-Off Operation. They need to be destroyed to free Trapped Whelplings.
Stomach Turner is a delve power obtained from the Strange Disturbances in delves during Midnight Season 2.

The Stonedark clan is a relatively peaceful group of drogbar who live in the Stonedark Grotto in Highmountain, isolated from their more violent kin who live further south under the rule of Dargrul the Underking. They are led by Navarrogg.

The Stonehoof Tauren is a melee ground unit of the Horde family. The tauren is exceptionally beefy, having high movement thanks to her charge ability that allows her to hone in on targets right away. While her damage isn't her key feature, locking down enemies allows for other units to safely engage while they're focused on the Stonehoof tauren, or potentially buy time for reinforcements to a lane.

Stone of the Hearth has a chance to drop from Dr. Boom during Hearthstone's 10th Anniversary. When used, it causes the caster to kneel before a Hearthstone box, then be lifted by flying Hearthstone cards after the box opens.
Stone of The Unbound is located in the mountains north of Dornogal on the Isle of Dorn.
Stonehusk Broodwatchers are beetles found in Island Expeditions.
Stonehusk Harvesters are beetles found in Island Expeditions.
Stoneborn Enforcers are stoneborn found flying above the Pridefall Hamlet in Revendreth.
Stonebull Canoe is housing decor purchased from Ransa Greyfeather in Highmountain for .
Storm Breath is an ability used by Squally during a Pet Battle.
Storm-Infused Stone can be created from a Condensed Nature Magic and looted from a Primordial Wind Cache.
Stonescale Proto-Drakes are proto-dragons that can be seen flying above the Field of Flames and Skystone Falls in the Emerald Dream.
Storm Bolts is a Mountain Thane hero talent for warriors. It is an exclusive choice node with Storm Shield.
The Storage Locker can be found at Durnholde Keep in the after destroying the pile of Rubble. It contains the Rune of Fires Wake.

Storm Archon is an Offensive ability in Plunderstorm. Upon casting, it causes a long line of lightning strikes in front of the caster, then switches to .Upon casting, it then causes a long line of earthen spikes to appear in front of the caster, then switches to .Upon casting, it then causes a long line of fire to rise from the ground. Each element has the same range and damage as each other, making them functionally identical.

Storm Rider: Bronze is a feat of strength that can be earned by completing all the Storm Gryphon Races with the Algarian Stormrider. To start doing these races, be in a Dragon Isles zone and wait for Herald Flaps to spawn and offer Lightning Strikes.

Storm Rider: Silver is a feat of strength that can be earned by completing all the Storm Gryphon Races with the Algarian Stormrider at silver or higher. To start doing these races, be in a Dragon Isles zone and wait for Herald Flaps to spawn and offer Lightning Strikes.

Storm Rider: Gold is a feat of strength that can be earned by completing all the Storm Gryphon Races with the Algarian Stormrider at gold. To start doing these races, be in a Dragon Isles zone and wait for Herald Flaps to spawn and offer Lightning Strikes.

Stormforged Pursuers are iron dwarves who pursue players at the Foot Steppes in the Storm Peaks during Sniffing Out the Perpetrator. They have to be netted and slowed using the special abilities of the Frosthound (Alliance) or Frostbite (Horde) that players ride on during the quest. They drop no loot.
Stormgilded Celestial is a windsteed flying vendor mount available from Landro's Golden Loot Box, along with the Gilded Coil Spire. It is exclusively available on China realms.

Stormarion Assault is a public event that takes place at the Stormarion Citadel in the Voidstorm. Similar to games, players must protect the Singularity Anchor from three waves of enemies, increasingly more powerful than the last. At select locations, defenses can be placed to temporary block incoming enemies, with additional defenses opening after the first and second wave. The Stormarion Asssault (world quest) world quest is available each week, rewarding the Victorious Stormarion Pinnacle Cache (a pinnacle cache). The Victorious Stormarion Cache is available for players below level 90.
, a storm worg on the Isle of Dorn ( model).]] Storm worgs are thunder magic worgs found in the Storm Peaks, the Vale of Eternal Blossoms, and the Isle of Dorn.
Storm of the Ages is an ability card from the Betrayal of the Guardian set.

Stormproof Sloop is a consumable item in Plunderstorm. It negates a single instance of damage. Using the sloop and then standing in the storm with it will cause it to catch fire. This temporarily reduces damage taken from the storm, increases movement speed, and replaces the basic combo ability with: : File:Stormproof Sloop lootable.jpg|Stormproof Sloop lootable. File:Stormproof Sloop.jpg|Stormproof Sloop. File:Stormproof Sloop on fire.jpg|On fire.

Stormshroud Peak is an area in Thaldraszus, located west of the Temporal Conflux and just east of Misty Vale. It consists of a perpetually stormy valley surrounded by mountains, with a small river running along the center and several caves along the cliffs. It is occupied by storm dragons, and numerous nests made of animal bones can be found both inside the caves and in the open. Additionally, pieces of the Orb of Rathmus were buried here, alongside stones hinting at their location with titan coordinates. When visited by Vyranoth and Wrathion, Thrymjaris mentions that while Odyn forbade the Thorignir from traveling to the Dragon Isles, "less honorable storm drakes" had already left for the i

Storming Elixirs drop from Treasure Goblins during the second A Greedy Emissary event. Using it near a Demon Portal that didn't already have it or don't have six affixes already would apply the following affix to it, which will spawn a Goblin with that ability: * **
Stormstream Totem is a shaman ability granted by the Stormstream Totem (shaman talent) apex talent.

Strands of Memory is located on a desk in the building in the southern part of the Skeins in the City of Threads. Its contents can only be understood while under the effects of Potion of Polymorphic Translation: Nerubian. Reading it is required for Smelling History.

Strange Disturbances are vignettes of rare elites that may appear inside any delve. Once defeated, they provide a specific delve power. Defeating 10 strange disturbances is required for the Stranger Delves achievement.
Stormwind Large Wooden Table is housing decor purchased from Captain Lancy Revshon in Stormwind City for .
Stormwind Wooden Table is housing decor obtained as a quest reward from Welcome to Stormwind. Additional copies can be purchased from Captain Lancy Revshon in Stormwind City for .
Stormwind Keg Stand is housing decor purchased from Captain Lancy Revshon in Stormwind City for .
Stormwind Gazebo is housing decor purchased from Captain Lancy Revshon in Stormwind City for .
Stormwind Trellis and Basin is housing decor purchased from Captain Lancy Revshon in Stormwind City for .
Stormwind Arched Trellis are housing decor obtained as a quest reward from Ending the Invasion!. Additional copies can be purchased from Captain Lancy Revshon in Stormwind City for .
Stormwind Lamppost is housing decor purchased from Captain Lancy Revshon in Stormwind City for .
Stormwind Forge is housing decor purchased from Captain Lancy Revshon in Stormwind City for .
Strength of Purpose drops from Lady Sarevess in Blackfathom Deeps.
Strength of the Black Ox is a Conduit of the Celestials monk hero talent.
Strength of the Warden is an Azerite Essence obtained from the Visions of N'Zoth. This essence can only be used by tank specializations.
Strength of Beledar is a bear located south of Velhan's Claim in Hallowfall.
Strategist: The War Within Season 1 is a feat of strength earned by winning 25 Rated Battleground Blitz matches while at Elite rank during The War Within Season 1.
Strategist: The War Within Season 2 is a feat of strength earned by winning 25 Rated Battleground Blitz matches while at Elite rank during The War Within Season 2.
Strategist: The War Within Season 3 is a feat of strength earned by winning 25 Rated Battleground Blitz matches while at Elite rank during The War Within Season 3.

Stranger on the Steps begins the optional "A Stranger's Gift" chapter of the Ghosts of K'aresh campaign. Find Om'taha outside Naakroa on the western island to begin. This chapter awards 350 reputation with the K'aresh Trust and Explorer 1 rings.
Strategist: Midnight Season 1 is a feat of strength earned by winning 25 Rated Battleground Blitz matches while at Elite rank during Midnight Season 1.

Strange Shore Crawlers are arcane-afflicted deepsea crabs exposed to the destruction of Dalaran and the resulting arcane chaos. As a result, they are Blinking across the shores of Hallowfall, primarily to the west of Mereldar. Their Arcane-Suffused Organs were desired by Wenren Althal, the final mage of the Hallowfall Expedition, who sought to use the magics that had affected them to return the lost expedition to their homeland and summon reinforcements. Although adventurers slew several of these crabs to assist Althal's efforts, the mage was slain shortly thereafter before he could help his people in returning home.
Strategist: Midnight Season 2 is a feat of strength earned by winning 25 Rated Battleground Blitz matches while at Elite rank during Midnight Season 2.

Subduer's Terrorgrips drop from Orator Krix'vizk in the City of Threads.
The Stuffed Barrel can be found in Kriegval's Rest and the Waterworks, providing a random delve power: *Lightning Bottle *Massive Shards of Amorphous Relic *Shard of Porcelain Arrowhead Idol
Stuffed Cave Peppers is made with Khaz Algar Cooking (45). The ability to make this food can be learned from the three cooking trainers on Khaz Algar: Athodas, Treagor, and Sauciere Drook.
Subterranean Predator is a passive racial ability for all haranir, increasing experience and damage against Aberrations, Beasts, and Elementals.

Submissive Mawrats are mawrats located in Tremaculum in the Maw. Lady Moonberry's Wand needs to be used on them during That's a Good Trick. Doing so makes them Enlarged Mawrat or Oddly Enlarged Mawrat.
Summer Soother's Hood is a quest reward from Power, Eruption, and Lies and Triple Threat (quest).
Summer Soother's Mitts are a quest reward from Flight and Fight and Light 'Em Up!.
Summer Soother's Gown is a quest reward from Defense of the Ancients (quest) and Power, Eruption, and Lies.
The Summon Random Favorite Mount ability is available from the Mounts tab. It summons a mount at random from those marked as favorites, or from the entire collection if there are no favorite mounts.

The Summon Random Favorite Battle Pet ability is available from the Pet Journal. It summons a battle pet at random from those marked as favorites, or from the entire collection if there are no favorite pets.
Summoned Visages are four Mueh'zala's projections located by the pillars in the Darkspear Training Grounds in Echo Isles. They guard the Tzadah's Empowerment totems.
Successfully Stress Test CN Realms is a feat of strength earned for participating in stress testing the realms in China.

Sul'lithuz Warders is an untargetable basilisk located in the mountains north of Antu'sul's lair in Zul'Farrak. It spawns once he starts yelling and comes running out of the cave. It despawns after around 7 minutes, or when Antu'sul is killed.
Suds is a goblin located in front of the Incontinental Hotel in the Undermine.
Summon Elemental Familiar is a shaman ability, available at level 25 by the glyph Glyph of Elemental Familiars.
Summon Archincubus is a warlock ability granted by the Grimoire of Supremacy (MoP Classic) talent.
Summit Sprites are sprites found up in the mountains east of Binan Village, at the border between the Jade Forest and Kun-Lai Summit.
The Sullen Cloudstrider is a cloudstrider found on a floating island underneath Hero's Rest in Bastion.

The Sufaadi are a group of ethereals affiliated with the Wastelanders and settled in the ruins of North Sufaad. Their rituals allowed them to cleanse objects and persons of the Void.

Talebound is a standalone game mode that will exist alongside the standard World of Warcraft gameplay. The mode can be played solo or cooperatively, combining combat, puzzles, and boss encounters across themed levels. The hub area for the game mode is the cozy village of Quillgrave, where players can rest between levels and upgrade their capabilities via specific town vendors. It is slated for release in patch 12.1.7 in late 2026.
